changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 3 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6872-app-shell-branding-title-jsdoc.md`

- names `content/docs/guide/layout.md` → `content/docs/guide/layout.md` — edited by this change

  > Correct the `AppShellBranding.title` doc comment. It read "Page title suffix (sets document.title)" while `useAppShellBranding` assigns `document.title = title` wholesale — nothing is appended; the caller composes the whole string (the console passes `"App label — Product name"`). That comment ships in `dist/index.d.ts` and is the only description a consumer sees on editor hover, so a reader who followed it passed a suffix-only fragment and got a truncated title with no error. The comment now carries the same wording as `content/docs/layout/app-shell.mdx`, and agrees with the `AppShellProps` tables in the package README and `content/docs/guide/layout.md`. No runtime behaviour changes; the wholesale assignment and the four-surface agreement are now pinned by tests.

### `.changeset/7926-page-node-refuses-actions.md`

- names `content/docs/guide/layout.md` → `content/docs/guide/layout.md` — edited by this change

  > **Scope.** One key, by name; the node is NOT strict. A census over this tree read 91 authored `page`-tagged objects with a blind-spot reading of 8 unreadable sites, and found only `actions` (3 sites, all in `content/docs/guide/layout.md`) and `breadcrumbs` (1 site, its own question, untouched) surviving passthrough on a real `page` node — every other undeclared key belongs to a different declaration that merely spells `type: 'page'`. `PageNodeSchema` still passes unknown renderer props through.

### `.changeset/8871-page-node-refuses-breadcrumbs.md`

- names `content/docs/guide/layout.md` → `content/docs/guide/layout.md` — edited by this change

  > Three author sites, all teaching passages in `content/docs/guide/layout.md`, and that count **corrects the `actions` refusal's "1 site"**: its census reads every git-tracked JSON file, every `json` fence in `.md`/`.mdx`, and every TS/TSX object literal via the TypeScript AST (PR #8870), and it undercounted for **two different reasons**. The Schema API block declared `breadcrumbs?: ArrayANGLE-BRACKETS({ label, href })` outright and its literal does carry `type: 'page'`, but that literal sits inside a markdown `typescript` fence — a fence **language** the census's `json`-fence reader never visits, so it was never read at all. Best Practices §2 authored it on a fragment inside a `json` fence the census does read, but that fragment never writes `type`, so a `page`-tagged filter correctly excluded it. No example app, catalog fixture, template or customer document writes the key, so the refusal strands no authored document in this tree.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Angle-bracketed names in the quoted prose above are rewritten as `ANGLE-BRACKETS(name)`: GitHub deletes tag-shaped fragments from a stored body, and a quote that silently loses the identifier it is about is worse than a visible repair.

Compared the checked-out tree with `50583364a` (merge-base with origin/main): 2 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1882 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2495 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36806834753)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `703d7385421db1cd1ce6dfea5a75914b6ff798b8`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card objectui#11298 (body; triage `5922545718`; claim `5923217045`; dev report `5923598012`; patch-round-1 report `5923725773`), PR objectui#11314 (body, 2-file list, the `changeset-claim-re-read` comment `5923540015`), the net diff `caa0cd3927..703d738542` (2 commits, 3 hunks, +3/-3, `content/docs/**` only), the 38 check-runs on the head, and source reads at the head: `packages/types/src/zod/{objectql,layout}.zod.ts`, `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/{tabs,flex,page}.tsx`, the `scripts/check-doc-*.mjs` headers, the three pending changesets the bot names. Branch point `caa0cd3927` is the merge-base; `git log caa0cd3927..origin/main` on both edited files is empty, and the three-dot stat equals the two-dot diff.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`layout.md` "With Action Buttons", `"object"` to `"objectName"` — right.** `ObjectGridSchema.objectName` is `z.string()`, required (`objectql.zod.ts:305`); `object` is no key of that schema. One line moved; the fence's buttons-in-`children` shape is untouched.
2. **`flex.mdx` Schema block, `'row' | 'column'` to `'row' | 'col' | 'row-reverse' | 'col-reverse'` — right.** `FlexSchema.direction` is `z.enum(['row', 'col', 'row-reverse', 'col-reverse'])` (`layout.zod.ts:339`, and `:366` on the public-block twin); `flex.tsx:29-32` maps exactly those four to `flex-row` / `flex-col` / `flex-row-reverse` / `flex-col-reverse` with no `column` branch. One line moved; the `align`, `justify`, `wrap`, `children` lines are untouched.
3. **`layout.md` "Settings Page with Tabs", `"tabs"` to `"items"` — right.** `TabsSchema.items` is `z.array(TabItemSchema)`, required (`layout.zod.ts:471`); `tabs.tsx:50` and `:61` read `schema.items`; `tabs` is undeclared on the node and `body` / `children` are tombstoned. One line moved. This is the third site the seat folded in on patch round 1; the claim's file surface is read as amended by the seat's ACCEPT.
4. **No alias, no renderer fallback — honoured.** Nothing under `packages/**` is in the diff.
5. **Census — holds on spot-check** (`git grep` at the head over `content/docs/**` and tracked `README.md`): no `object-grid` literal is followed by an `object` key (every remaining `"object":` sits inside a `dataSource`, `options.data` or `optionsFrom` sub-object, which is the spec's own spelling there); no `direction` is taught as `column` (the 3 remaining `direction` + `column` hits are the `flex direction gap` / `grid columns` html-block prose in `react-pages.md` and the react-runtime README, not a flex value); 6 `type: tabs` literals, the other 5 all under `items`; the remaining `tabs:` keys (`schema-reference.md:693`, `:1175`, `plugin-detail/README.md`) sit on `detail` / `detail-view` nodes, a different node type. Exactly one copy of each mistake existed, and all three are fixed.
6. **No pin — the reading is right.** `check-doc-snippet-types.mjs` compiles `ts` / `tsx` / `typescript` fences only and its header names schema-key validity as blind spot 1; `check-doc-fence-languages.mjs` judges fence language only and lists `flex.mdx` as one block of objectui#5867's shrink-only debt (`:422`); `check-doc-component-types.mjs` judges the `type` literal only; `check-doc-expression-carriage.mjs` is report-only, and its own header says a json fence on these pages can author any key and no gate objects. Of the tests that read `layout.md`, the two that call `safeParse` (`page-actions-refusal-7926`, `page-breadcrumbs-refusal-8871`) parse their own fixtures and scan the guide's json fences for the retired key by name; neither validates a fence, and no test reads `flex.mdx`. The ruling's condition ("if the repo's snippet checks reach these fences") is unmet, and a new gate is default-no. Noted, not owed: a fence-reading pin in the `readme-kanban-example-8256` / `timeline-readme-schema-example-10824` shape would have needed no gate.
7. **Pending-changeset re-read — no sentence falsified.** `6872` cites the `AppShellProps` table in `layout.md`, untouched. `7926`'s "3 sites … rewritten onto the shape that draws, and pinned by their rendered result" still holds: the With Action Buttons fence keeps its buttons in `children`, the hunk is on the sibling `object-grid` node, and `guide-layout-page-buttons-7926.test.tsx` is among the 23 the dev ran green. `8871`'s "three author sites" and its "There is no `breadcrumbs` array" passage are untouched. No body correction is owed.
8. **Public surface: none.** No export, schema, prop or renderer changes; the accept-set is unchanged on both faces.
9. **Check-runs on the head.** 28 `success`, 3 `skipped` (coverage shard, coverage, dependabot — the path switch), 7 `in_progress` and **not concluded**: Spec Main Shape Gate, Test shards 1/8, 2/8, 3/8, 5/8, 7/8, 8/8 (shards 4/8 and 6/8 are `success`; no Test roll-up exists on this head yet). Doc Snippet Type Check `success` closes the dev's NOT MEASURED; Lint `success` closes the dev's unmeasured lint; Changeset Declaration, Changeset Claim Re-read, Doc Fence Language Check, Doc Component Type Check, Internal Docs Link Check, Build Docs, Type Check and Test (dist pins) are `success`. The earlier Test failure on `680a2be4b4` was the roll-up cancelled by the patch-round push and is not read.

### ② Semver level

- **No changeset — right.** `check-changeset-presence.mjs` guards `pkg/src/**` of the `fixed` group only; `content/docs/**` is outside it, and the Changeset Declaration check-run is `success` on the head. No `skip-changeset` label, and the PR body is right that nothing in this repo reads one.
- **`Clause-②: no` — right.** Docs only; no accept-set change on the tolerant or the strict face; the schemas are the instrument, not the patient.
- Level: none (docs are not a released package).

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions`: `[]` in both rounds.** Nothing to answer.
- **Dev flag, both rounds — the PR body is stale and the dev does not PATCH.** Owed by the seat before the PR leaves draft: (a) a third Site row for the `tabs` to `items` hunk; (b) the Acceptance notes' last bullet drops the "Settings Page with Tabs" hand-off (fixed at this head) and rewords the grid half as "five `object-grid` nodes that carry no `objectName` (three bind through `dataSource`, one through `bind`, one through `rowData`), carried by objectui#11276"; (c) the Checks section cites `680a2be4b4`, and patch round 1 re-ran them at `703d738542`. Not blocking the verdict on the diff: the card's two reports carry the true description.
- **Dev flag — commit trailer uses the repo's model-free pair** per objectui AGENTS.md precedence. Accepted; no action.
- **Out-of-scope 1 (tabs fence)** — folded on patch round 1 and fixed at this head. Closed.
- **Out-of-scope 2 (`object-grid` with `dataSource` and no `objectName`)** — verified at the head: `objectName` is required (`objectql.zod.ts:305`) while `dataSource` is optional, by reference to the spec's element binding (`:312`), whose comment says the registered renderer reads it through `ElementDataSourceGate`. A contract decision, not a docs edit. Carrier objectui#11276's `object-grid` batch is right, that batch owning the node's spelling, with one condition: the batch must carry the requiredness question by name (five docs grids depend on it), else a class (b) card of its own is owed. Escalated to the seat as one line on objectui#11276.
- **Out-of-scope 3 (`flex.mdx` `align` / `justify` subsets, `children` shown required)** — carrier objectui#11300's corpus is right; triage named `flex.mdx` as that decision's corpus. Nothing owed here.
- **Out-of-scope 4 (strict face, "carrier: none") — escalated; it is worth a line, and the page half is fileable.** Verified at the head: `maxWidth` / `padding` at `layout.zod.ts:310-315` belong to `ContainerSchema`; `PageNodeSchema` (`:835`) declares neither in its own extension; and `page.tsx` (the registered `page` renderer, `:801`) has no read for either key — its max-width class comes from `pageType` through `getPageMaxWidth` (`:655`). So `layout.md:241`, `:500`, `:744` (`maxWidth` on a `page` node) and `:661` (`"padding": false` on a `page` node, under the heading "Control page content padding") teach keys the page renderer never reads: the tolerant face passes them unjudged through passthrough and draws nothing, the objectui#7926 / #8871 shape on the same node. The `action:button` half (flat `variant` / `icon` / `actionType`) is the declared public-block state (changeset `10872-held-public-block-arms`: flat props pass the tolerant face, the strict face refuses them, `properties` passes both), so it belongs with the properties-bag family and PR objectui#11069's un-park census. Owed: one line on objectui#11069's un-park census for all five fences, and a class (c) card for the four page sites (dedupe words: `layout.md page maxWidth inert` · `page padding false not read` · `PageRenderer getPageMaxWidth pageType`). Not this PR's surface; not blocking.
- **7 check-runs in progress** are named above as not concluded. The seat's merge waits on them; this verdict reads them neither as pass nor as fail.
- **Draft PR** — the seat marks it ready after the body PATCH.
